title: We’re gonna need a lot more mathematicians
author: Reader on Sahai's post

metaphors.title: Helicopter to the summit, or to Narnia
metaphors.paraphrase: Using AI on old problems is a helicopter to a familiar summit; real discovery would be a helicopter into a strange, fertile Narnia.

metaphors.title: Endgame tablebases
metaphors.paraphrase: Chess ignored superhuman tablebase mates via the 50-move rule; math could ignore results humans can't verify.

metaphors.title: Deployable intellectual reserve
metaphors.paraphrase: Mathematicians as a reserve humanity can call on, e.g. to vet an AI-designed terawatt fusion plant.
